read_lines =: 3 : '<;._2 (1!:1 <y)'
num =: 3 : 0
    if. '-'={.y do.
        -0".}.y
    else.
        0".y
    end.
)
intdiv =: 4 : '<.(x: x)%x: y'
text =: 3 : 0
    value =. ":y
    '-'(I.value='_')}value
)
words =: 3 : 0
    parts =. <;._1 ' ',y
    (0<#&>parts)#parts
)
join =: 4 : 0
    result =. ''
    for_index. i.#y do.
        if. index do.
            result =. result,x
        end.
        result =. result,index{::y
    end.
    result
)
valid_number =: 3 : 0
    if. (0=#y)+.6<#y do.
        0 return.
    end.
    if. -.*./y e.'0123456789' do.
        0 return.
    end.
    ((,y)-:,'0')+.'0'~:{.y
)
valid_literal =: 3 : 0
    if. (,y)-:,'0' do.
        1 return.
    end.
    digits =. y
    if. #y do.
        if. '-'={.y do.
            digits =. }.y
        end.
    end.
    (valid_number digits)*.-.(,digits)-:,'0'
)
dimacs_error =: 3 : '(<0),(<0$a:),<y'
read_dimacs =: 3 : 0
    variables =. _1
    declared =. _1
    clauses =. 0$a:
    partial =. i.0
    lines =. read_lines 'input/',y
    for_index. i.#lines do.
        line =. index{::lines
        number =. index+1
        tokens =. words line
        if. 0=#tokens do.
            continue.
        end.
        if. 'c'={.line do.
            continue.
        end.
        if. (,'p')-:,0{::tokens do.
            if. variables>:0 do.
                dimacs_error 'duplicate header at line ',text number return.
            end.
            valid =. 4=#tokens
            if. valid do.
                valid =. ('cnf'-:1{::tokens)*.(valid_number 2{::tokens)*.valid_number 3{::tokens
            end.
            if. -.valid do.
                dimacs_error 'bad header at line ',text number return.
            end.
            variables =. num 2{::tokens
            declared =. num 3{::tokens
        else.
            if. variables<0 do.
                dimacs_error 'missing header' return.
            end.
            for_box. tokens do.
                token =. >box
                if. -.valid_literal token do.
                    dimacs_error 'bad token ',token,' at line ',text number return.
                end.
                literal =. num token
                if. (|literal)>variables do.
                    dimacs_error 'literal out of range ',token,' at line ',text number return.
                end.
                if. literal=0 do.
                    clauses =. clauses,<partial
                    partial =. i.0
                else.
                    partial =. partial,literal
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    if. variables<0 do.
        dimacs_error 'missing header'
    elseif. #partial do.
        dimacs_error 'unterminated clause'
    elseif. declared~:#clauses do.
        dimacs_error 'clause count mismatch header=',(text declared),' found=',text #clauses
    else.
        (<variables),(<clauses),<''
    end.
)
model_lines =: 3 : 0
    literals =. (1+i.#y)*((2*y)-1)
    tokens =. (text&.>literals),<'0'
    lines =. 0$a:
    for_start. 10*i.>.(#tokens)%10 do.
        fields =. (start+i.10<.(#tokens)-start){tokens
        lines =. lines,<'v ',' 'join fields
    end.
    lines
)

literal_value =: 3 : 0
    truth =. ((|y)-1){RoundAssignment
    if. truth<0 do.
        _1
    elseif. y>0 do.
        truth
    else.
        1-truth
    end.
)
assign_literal =: 3 : 0
    'literal kind' =. y
    RoundAssignment =: (literal>0)((|literal)-1)}RoundAssignment
    RoundTrail =: RoundTrail,literal,kind
    RoundTrace =: RoundTrace,<((kind{'DFP'),text literal)
    0
)
record_conflict =: 3 : 0
    RoundConflicts =: RoundConflicts+1
    RoundTrace =: RoundTrace,<'C'
    0
)
run_round =: 3 : 0
    'variables clauses' =. y
    RoundAssignment =: variables$_1
    RoundTrail =: 0 2$0
    RoundTrace =: 0$a:
    RoundDecisions =: 0
    RoundPropagations =: 0
    RoundConflicts =: 0
    RoundMaxDepth =: 0
    watches =. (1+2*variables)$<i.0
    queue_head =. 0
    for_index. i.#clauses do.
        clause =. index{::clauses
        if. 2<:#clause do.
            for_literal. 2{.clause do.
                watched =. variables+literal
                watches =. (<(watched{::watches),index)watched}watches
            end.
        end.
    end.
    for_box. clauses do.
        clause =. >box
        if. 0=#clause do.
            record_conflict 0
            (<0),(<i.0),(<RoundTrace),<RoundDecisions,RoundPropagations,RoundConflicts,RoundMaxDepth return.
        end.
        if. 1=#clause do.
            truth =. literal_value {.clause
            if. truth=0 do.
                record_conflict 0
                (<0),(<i.0),(<RoundTrace),<RoundDecisions,RoundPropagations,RoundConflicts,RoundMaxDepth return.
            elseif. truth<0 do.
                assign_literal ({.clause),2
                RoundPropagations =: RoundPropagations+1
            end.
        end.
    end.
    finished =. 0
    satisfiable =. 0
    while. -.finished do.
        found_conflict =. 0
        while. queue_head<#RoundTrail do.
            false_literal =. -(<queue_head,0){RoundTrail
            queue_head =. queue_head+1
            watched =. variables+false_literal
            watch_list =. watched{::watches
            index =. 0
            while. index<#watch_list do.
                clause_id =. index{watch_list
                clause =. clause_id{::clauses
                if. false_literal=0{clause do.
                    clause =. (1 0{clause)0 1}clause
                    clauses =. (<clause)clause_id}clauses
                end.
                other =. 0{clause
                if. 1=literal_value other do.
                    index =. index+1
                    continue.
                end.
                substitute =. _1
                for_position. 2+i.(#clause)-2 do.
                    if. 0~:literal_value position{clause do.
                        substitute =. position
                        break.
                    end.
                end.
                if. substitute>:0 do.
                    saved =. 1{clause
                    clause =. (substitute{clause)1}clause
                    clause =. saved substitute}clause
                    clauses =. (<clause)clause_id}clauses
                    watch_list =. (index{.watch_list),(index+1)}.watch_list
                    new_watch =. variables+1{clause
                    watches =. (<(new_watch{::watches),clause_id)new_watch}watches
                    continue.
                end.
                truth =. literal_value other
                if. truth=0 do.
                    record_conflict 0
                    found_conflict =. 1
                    break.
                elseif. truth<0 do.
                    assign_literal other,2
                    RoundPropagations =: RoundPropagations+1
                end.
                index =. index+1
            end.
            watches =. (<watch_list)watched}watches
            if. found_conflict do.
                break.
            end.
        end.
        if. found_conflict do.
            while. #RoundTrail do.
                'literal kind' =. {:RoundTrail
                if. kind=0 do.
                    break.
                end.
                RoundAssignment =: _1 ((|literal)-1)}RoundAssignment
                RoundTrail =: }:RoundTrail
            end.
            if. 0=#RoundTrail do.
                finished =. 1
            else.
                decision =. (<((#RoundTrail)-1),0){RoundTrail
                RoundAssignment =: _1 ((|decision)-1)}RoundAssignment
                RoundTrail =: }:RoundTrail
                assign_literal (-decision),1
                queue_head =. (#RoundTrail)-1
            end.
        else.
            counts =. (1+2*variables)$0
            for_box. clauses do.
                clause =. >box
                values =. literal_value"0 clause
                if. 1 e.values do.
                    continue.
                end.
                for_literal. (values<0)#clause do.
                    location =. variables+literal
                    counts =. (1+location{counts)location}counts
                end.
            end.
            best =. 0
            maximum =. 0
            for_variable. 1+i.variables do.
                for_literal. variable,-variable do.
                    count =. (variables+literal){counts
                    if. count>maximum do.
                        maximum =. count
                        best =. literal
                    end.
                end.
            end.
            if. best=0 do.
                satisfiable =. 1
                finished =. 1
            else.
                assign_literal best,0
                RoundDecisions =: RoundDecisions+1
                depth =. +/(1{"1 RoundTrail)e.0 1
                RoundMaxDepth =: RoundMaxDepth>.depth
            end.
        end.
    end.
    (<satisfiable),(<RoundAssignment=1),(<RoundTrace),<RoundDecisions,RoundPropagations,RoundConflicts,RoundMaxDepth
)

queens =: 3 : 0
    n =. y
    clauses =. 0$a:
    for_row. i.n do.
        clauses =. clauses,<(row*n)+1+i.n
    end.
    for_first. 1+i.n*n do.
        row_first =. (first-1)intdiv n
        column_first =. n|first-1
        for_second. (first+1)+i.(n*n)-first do.
            row_second =. (second-1)intdiv n
            column_second =. n|second-1
            if. (row_first=row_second)+.(column_first=column_second)+.(|row_first-row_second)=|column_first-column_second do.
                clauses =. clauses,<(-first),-second
            end.
        end.
    end.
    (<n*n),(<clauses),<''
)
pigeon =: 3 : 0
    'pigeons holes' =. y
    clauses =. 0$a:
    for_bird. i.pigeons do.
        clauses =. clauses,<(bird*holes)+1+i.holes
    end.
    for_bird. i.pigeons do.
        for_first. 1+i.holes do.
            for_second. (first+1)+i.holes-first do.
                clauses =. clauses,<(-((bird*holes)+first)),-((bird*holes)+second)
            end.
        end.
    end.
    for_hole. 1+i.holes do.
        for_first. i.pigeons do.
            for_second. (first+1)+i.(pigeons-1)-first do.
                clauses =. clauses,<(-((first*holes)+hole)),-((second*holes)+hole)
            end.
        end.
    end.
    (<pigeons*holes),(<clauses),<''
)
coloring =: 3 : 0
    'vertices edges colors' =. y
    clauses =. 0$a:
    for_vertex. i.vertices do.
        clauses =. clauses,<(vertex*colors)+1+i.colors
    end.
    for_vertex. i.vertices do.
        for_first. 1+i.colors do.
            for_second. (first+1)+i.colors-first do.
                clauses =. clauses,<(-((vertex*colors)+first)),-((vertex*colors)+second)
            end.
        end.
    end.
    for_edge. edges do.
        for_color. 1+i.colors do.
            first =. (((0{edge)-1)*colors)+color
            second =. (((1{edge)-1)*colors)+color
            clauses =. clauses,<(-first),-second
        end.
    end.
    (<vertices*colors),(<clauses),<''
)
positions =: 4 : 0
    'rows width' =. y
    matrix =. (rows,width)$x
    result =. i.0
    for_row. matrix do.
        result =. result,1+row i.1
    end.
    result
)

finish_graph =: 3 : 0
    'name vertices edges reason' =. y
    edges =. /:~edges
    neighbors =. (vertices,vertices)$0
    degree =. vertices$0
    for_edge. edges do.
        'first second' =. edge-1
        neighbors =. 1 (<first,second)}neighbors
        neighbors =. 1 (<second,first)}neighbors
        degree =. (1+first{degree)first}degree
        degree =. (1+second{degree)second}degree
    end.
    order =. /:(-degree),.i.vertices
    colors =. vertices$0
    for_vertex. order do.
        present =. (vertex{neighbors)#colors
        candidate =. 1
        while. candidate e.present do.
            candidate =. candidate+1
        end.
        colors =. candidate vertex}colors
    end.
    (<name),(<vertices),(<edges),(<reason),(<colors),(< >./colors),< >./degree
)
load_graphs =: 3 : 0
    graphs =. 0$a:
    current =. 0
    lines =. read_lines 'input/graphs.txt'
    for_index. i.#lines do.
        line =. index{::lines
        if. -.current do.
            if. 0=#line do.
                continue.
            end.
            if. '#'={.line do.
                continue.
            end.
            header =. words line
            name =. 1{::header
            vertices =. num 2{::header
            edges =. 0 2$0
            reason =. ''
            current =. 1
        elseif. line-:'END' do.
            graphs =. graphs,<finish_graph (<name),(<vertices),(<edges),<reason
            current =. 0
        elseif. 0=#reason do.
            tokens =. words line
            issue =. ''
            valid =. 2=#tokens
            if. valid do.
                valid =. *./valid_number&>tokens
            end.
            if. -.valid do.
                issue =. 'bad edge line'
            else.
                pair =. num&>tokens
                if. +./(pair<1)+.pair>vertices do.
                    issue =. 'vertex out of range'
                elseif. =/pair do.
                    issue =. 'self loop'
                else.
                    pair =. /:~pair
                    if. (<pair)e.<"1 edges do.
                        issue =. 'duplicate edge'
                    else.
                        edges =. edges,pair
                    end.
                end.
            end.
            if. #issue do.
                reason =. issue,' at line ',text index+1
            end.
        end.
    end.
    graphs
)
load_jobs =: 3 : 0
    jobs =. 0$a:
    for_box. read_lines 'input/jobs.txt' do.
        line =. >box
        if. 0=#line do.
            continue.
        end.
        if. '#'={.line do.
            continue.
        end.
        tokens =. words line
        record =. (<1+#jobs),(<line),(<0{::tokens),(<}.tokens),(<''),(<_1),(<0),(<0$a:),(<0$a:),(<4$0),(<0),(<0),(<0$a:),<0$a:
        jobs =. jobs,<record
    end.
    jobs
)
validate =: 3 : 0
    command =. job_command y
    args =. job_args y
    command_index =. Commands i.<command
    if. command_index=#Commands do.
        'unknown command ',command return.
    end.
    kinds =. command_index{::ArgumentTypes
    if. (#kinds)~:#args do.
        'wrong argument count' return.
    end.
    for_index. i.#args do.
        token =. index{::args
        kind =. index{::kinds
        if. kind-:'file' do.
            valid =. (5<:#token)*.(#token)<:24
            if. valid do.
                stem =. _4}.token
                valid =. ('.cnf'-:_4{.token)*.*./stem e.'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_'
            end.
            if. -.valid do.
                'bad file name ',token return.
            end.
        elseif. kind-:'graph' do.
            location =. (graph_name&.>Graphs)i.<token
            if. location=#Graphs do.
                'unknown graph ',token return.
            end.
            reason =. graph_error location{::Graphs
            if. #reason do.
                'invalid graph ',token,': ',reason return.
            end.
        else.
            if. -.valid_number token do.
                'bad number ',token return.
            end.
            maximum =. 200
            if. kind-:'small' do.
                maximum =. 8
            elseif. kind-:'color' do.
                maximum =. 6
            end.
            value =. num token
            if. (value<1)+.value>maximum do.
                'out of range ',token return.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    ''
)
solve_formula =: 3 : 0
    'variables clauses limit' =. y
    preparation =. preprocess (<variables),(<clauses),<limit=1
    'simplified fixed active counts records empty pure' =. preparation
    models =. 0$a:
    blocking =. 0$a:
    counters =. 4$0
    events =. 0$a:
    rounds =. 0
    stop =. 'limit'
    if. empty>:0 do.
        stop =. 'preprocess'
    else.
        while. (#models)<limit do.
            rounds =. rounds+1
            'satisfiable model trace stats' =. run_round (<variables),<simplified,blocking
            if. rounds=1 do.
                events =. trace
            end.
            counters =. counters add_stats stats
            if. -.satisfiable do.
                stop =. 'all'
                break.
            end.
            fixed_indices =. I.fixed>:0
            model =. (fixed_indices{fixed)fixed_indices}model
            models =. models,<model
            block =. active*(1-2*(active-1){model)
            blocking =. blocking,<block
        end.
    end.
    status =. 'UNSAT'
    if. #models do.
        status =. 'SAT'
    end.
    (<variables),(<clauses),(<models),(<status),(<rounds),(<stop),(<events),(<counters),(<preparation),(<7{counts),<0
)
true_count =: 4 : '+/(((|y)-1){x)=y>0'
satisfies =: 4 : 0
    for_box. y do.
        if. 0=x true_count >box do.
            0 return.
        end.
    end.
    1
)
analyze =: 3 : 0
    variables =. sol_variables y
    clauses =. sol_clauses y
    models =. sol_models y
    if. 0=#models do.
        0$a: return.
    end.
    failure =. i.0
    distribution =. i.0
    for_index. i.#models do.
        model =. index{::models
        for_clause_index. i.#clauses do.
            count =. model true_count clause_index{::clauses
            if. index=0 do.
                distribution =. distribution,count
            end.
            if. (count=0)*.0=#failure do.
                failure =. (index+1),clause_index+1
            end.
        end.
    end.
    first =. 0{::models
    safe =. i.0
    backbone =. i.0
    for_variable. i.variables do.
        flipped =. (1-variable{first)variable}first
        if. flipped satisfies clauses do.
            safe =. safe,variable+1
        end.
        if. *./(variable{first)=variable{&>models do.
            backbone =. backbone,(variable+1)*((2*variable{first)-1)
        end.
    end.
    diversity =. i.0
    for_first_index. i.#models do.
        for_second_index. (first_index+1)+i.(#models)-(first_index+1) do.
            diversity =. diversity,+/(first_index{::models)~:second_index{::models
        end.
    end.
    (<failure),(<distribution),(<safe),(<diversity),<backbone
)
unsat_core =: 3 : 0
    'variables clauses' =. y
    remaining =. (#clauses)$1
    decisions =. 0
    conflicts =. 0
    for_remove. i.#clauses do.
        selected =. 0 remove}remaining
        solution =. solve_formula (<variables),(<selected#clauses),<1
        stats =. sol_stats solution
        decisions =. decisions+0{stats
        conflicts =. conflicts+2{stats
        if. 'UNSAT'-:sol_status solution do.
            remaining =. selected
        end.
    end.
    (<1+I.remaining),(<decisions),<conflicts
)
execute_job =: 3 : 0
    job =. y
    reason =. validate job
    if. #reason do.
        (<reason)4}job return.
    end.
    args =. job_args job
    command =. job_command job
    if. command-:'CHROMATIC' do.
        graph_index =. (graph_name&.>Graphs)i.0{args
        graph =. graph_index{::Graphs
        attempts =. 0$a:
        counters =. 4$0
        rounds =. 0
        removed =. 0
        for_colors. 1+i.num 1{::args do.
            'variables clauses reason' =. coloring (<graph_vertices graph),(<graph_edges graph),<colors
            solution =. solve_formula (<variables),(<clauses),<1
            solution =. (<colors)10}solution
            attempts =. attempts,<solution
            counters =. counters add_stats sol_stats solution
            rounds =. rounds+sol_rounds solution
            removed =. removed+sol_removed solution
            if. 'SAT'-:sol_status solution do.
                break.
            end.
        end.
        job =. (<graph_index)5}job
        job =. (<colors)6}job
        job =. (<attempts)8}job
    else.
        if. (<command)e.;:'SOLVE ENUM CORE' do.
            'variables clauses reason' =. read_dimacs 0{::args
            if. #reason do.
                (<reason)4}job return.
            end.
            limit =. 1
            if. command-:'ENUM' do.
                limit =. num 1{::args
            end.
        elseif. command-:'QUEENS' do.
            'variables clauses reason' =. queens num 0{::args
            limit =. num 1{::args
        elseif. command-:'PIGEON' do.
            'variables clauses reason' =. pigeon num&>2{.args
            limit =. num 2{::args
        else.
            graph_index =. (graph_name&.>Graphs)i.0{args
            graph =. graph_index{::Graphs
            colors =. num 1{::args
            'variables clauses reason' =. coloring (<graph_vertices graph),(<graph_edges graph),<colors
            limit =. num 2{::args
            job =. (<graph_index)5}job
            job =. (<colors)6}job
        end.
        solution =. solve_formula (<variables),(<clauses),<limit
        counters =. sol_stats solution
        rounds =. sol_rounds solution
        removed =. sol_removed solution
        if. (command-:'CORE')*.'UNSAT'-:sol_status solution do.
            core =. unsat_core (<variables),<clauses
            job =. (<core)12}job
        end.
    end.
    job =. (<solution)7}job
    job =. (<counters)9}job
    job =. (<rounds)10}job
    job =. (<removed)11}job
    job =. (<analyze solution)13}job
    job
)
heading =: 3 : '''JOB '',(text job_number y),'' '',job_text y'
formula_summary =: 3 : 0
    'variables clauses' =. y
    lengths =. #&>clauses
    'variables=',(text variables),' clauses=',(text #clauses),' literals=',(text +/lengths),' lengths=',frequency lengths
)
graph_summary =: 3 : 0
    'graph vertices=',(text graph_vertices y),' edges=',(text #graph_edges y),' max_degree=',(text graph_degree y),' greedy=',text graph_used y
)
preprocessing_report =: 3 : 0
    'clauses fixed active counts records empty pure' =. y
    values =. (<pure{::'off';'on'),text&.>counts
    lines =. <'preprocess ',(;:'pure tautologies duplicate_literals unit_fixed unit_removed subsumed pure_fixed pure_removed removed')named values
    lines =. lines,<'removed_clauses ',(;:'tautology unit subsumed pure')named number_list&.>records
    if. empty>:0 do.
        lines =. lines,<'simplified empty_clause=',text empty
    else.
        lengths =. #&>clauses
        indices =. I.fixed>:0
